# Erique Berdos

> Erique Berdos, also known professionally as Eriq Berdos, is a web developer, systems architect and automation specialist based in Davao City, Philippines.

## Official links
- [Portfolio](https://qir05.github.io/PortfolioEbberdos/): Biography, services, selected work and contact details.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Qir05): Development profile.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erique-berdos-0062aa309/): Professional profile.
- [Vaze demo lab](https://vaze-demo-websites.vercel.app/): Multi-industry demonstration websites; demos are not client businesses.

## Services
- Web development: Next.js, React, WordPress and Squarespace.
- Systems architecture, REST APIs, webhooks and integrations.
- GoHighLevel and HubSpot CRM workflows and business automation.
- SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO).
- Social media management, content planning and page management.
- Meta Ads: Facebook and Instagram campaigns and retargeting.
- GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
- Deployment, QA and technical operations.
